correctness.rationale: In odd characteristic the commutation condition is exactly a_odd∧b_odd=0; the centralizer index is q^rank and all 15 even coordinates are free. Independently, for a_odd=v+α+β with v≠0, split V=⟨v⟩⊕W. The degree-two projection has rank 4. On its kernel the degree-four image is v∧Λ³W of dimension 4: b_1 is a multiple of v and the contribution α∧b_1 is already in that image. This gives rank 8 and (q⁵−1)q²⁶ elements. When v=0, the perfect top wedge pairing identifies α with an alternating form on V. The radicals of nonzero forms have dimensions 3 or 1; each quotient contributes q−1 or |GL₄|/|Sp₄|=q²(q−1)(q³−1), respectively. This gives N₂,N₄ as stated, with q¹⁶ free lifts per form. Divide element counts by 1,q²,q⁴,q⁸ to obtain each coefficient; weighted mass is q³¹. In odd characteristic positive-even units are central and every unit factors into such a unit and 1+u with u odd; u²=0 and [1+u,1+w]=1+2u∧w. Noncommuting generator pairs establish class exactly two. The squarefree alternating convention implies commutativity in characteristic two. Nonzero scalars split off centrally without altering class sizes, multiplying counts by q−1.

value.rationale: The natural exact invariant is the ordinary class-size distribution of a principal-unit group, not an arbitrary count of vectors. Rank five is the first odd-generator case with two distinct nonzero alternating ranks for the leading cubic part; the exact polynomial locates and quantifies those strata and the conspicuous missing q⁶ size.
